chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about dividing the surah, and he said: I dislike it, but there is no problem with it in the supererogatory prayer.

key_terms.السُّورَةِ: a surah of the Qur'an recited in salat
key_terms.تَبْعِيضِ: dividing or reciting only part of something; here, part of a surah
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or harm in it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite only part of a surah in obligatory or supererogatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on reciting only part of a surah in salat. It indicates dislike for doing so, while permitting it in the nafilah prayer, reflecting a distinction in recitation rules between obligatory and supererogatory prayers.
